Dear Sir, 
 
Sub: Presentation for Analyst / Institutional Investor Meet  
This is in continuation to our letter dated 15th April 2026, wherein we had provided an advance intimation 
regarding the Press/Analyst / Institutional Investor Meet scheduled to be held today i.e. 20th April 2026 
at 05.30 p.m. (IST), in terms of Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015.  
We are enclosing herewith the presentation to be delivered at the aforesaid Analyst / Institutional Investor 
Meet.  
Please note that no unpublished price sensitive information is proposed to be shared by the Company 
during the aforesaid meet.  
This intimation is also being uploaded at the Company’s website at https://www.smlmahindra.com. 
 
 
Yours faithfully, 
 
For SML MAHINDRA LIMITED 
(Formerly SML ISUZU LIMITED) 
 
 
 
(DR. VENKATARAMAN SRINIVAS)
